references.text: The previous verse describes the actual event where the spies cut down a vine with its cluster of grapes at the Brook Eshcol
The Valley of Eshcol is mentioned again in connection with the spies' exploration of the land
Moses recounts how the spies came to the Valley of Eshcol and brought back fruit from the land
Eshcol is mentioned as one of Abraham's allies, and the name Eshcol means 'cluster of grapes' - the same word used in this verse
Eshcol is mentioned again as Abraham's ally, with the same meaning of his name linked to a cluster of grapes
